provenance.scope: Complete listed native functions on preallocated objects/groups. Full 00404D40 cases use existing groups and an explicitly bound pending anchor; no allocation or deleting paths execute.
provenance.excluded: CRT allocation/free, first-load group allocation, invalid-node deletion, last-member group free, allocation failure, cyclic recursive lookup, post-load world passes.

normalization.ids: Pointers normalize to object/group IDs. Common-list nodes are [object ID, native offset].
normalization.unknown: Uninitialized position and group flag bytes are null; allocation poison and padding are independently checked.
normalization.seed: Explicit supplied preconditions, not claimed native effects. Group binding in finalizer cases belongs to the already-completed prior stage.
normalization.whole_finalizer: Pending anchor remains pending so 00404F40 can find it; reversed dependencies require repeated 00405010 passes. Every instruction of 00404D40 executes normally on the reached branches.
